scope: synthetic-only bounded FULL_DATASET whole-feed replacement and explicitly driven process-local worker queue; no network ingestion, API startup or delivery

redis_environment.volume: no host volume; no payload persistence enabled
redis_environment.test_cleanup: unique per-test namespaces only; no FLUSHDB/FLUSHALL

behavior_verified: atomic manifest/generation payload replacement and omission deletion, including empty successful FULL_DATASET
missing GPS, withdrawn evidence, feed silence and feed failure never infer cancellation or confirmed recovery
header timestamps order snapshots; equal canonical content is duplicate, equal timestamp changed content conflicts; entity reordering is identical
opaque feed_version must match constructor configuration; only standard header wire field 4 added through a private descriptor pool
GPS/trip observation freshness and original receipt time survive header refresh and identical reintroduction after omission
retained order/receipt/hashed-vehicle guards prevent replay and same-vehicle omission-gap jump bypass without storing position history
future/disjoint/open advisory alert intervals activate inclusively and expire exclusively on read; finite final ends cap physical TTL
multiple alerts remain independent; inactive alert fanout, bytes, jobs, records, serialized manifest and retry counts are bounded
concurrent whole-feed writers/readers, genuine WATCH races and contention exhaustion do not expose mixed generations
generation integrity is checked before duplicate acknowledgement and all trip reads; corrupt/incomplete state fails unavailable/unknown
lost EXEC response can be retried as an intact duplicate; no false local commit success
backpressure includes in-flight/retry jobs and byte budget; concurrent producers cannot exceed capacity
deterministic retry delays and exhaustion; stale queued work and older headers cannot roll state back
legacy event-state namespace and public API/Auth/database/mobile sources are unchanged

actual_outage_restart_experiment.target: only the task-created disposable container, exact container ID checked before stop/start
actual_outage_restart_experiment.while_stopped: reads/writes unavailable, service unknown, queued retry retains its capacity slot
actual_outage_restart_experiment.after_nonpersistent_restart: cold-cache unknown; queued retry accepted; reconstructed-worker resubmission duplicate; expired replay rejected
actual_outage_restart_experiment.limits: worker reconstruction is not a process-crash durability proof; ephemeral queue/guards do not survive process/server loss; producer resubmission required

remaining: durable ingestion evidence, retention and restart watermark policy through reviewed migrations
owner-controlled source provenance and immutable static-snapshot/version binding
production feed fetching/orchestration, distributed durable queue/ack and broader GTFS-RT support
Redis ACL/TLS, noeviction/capacity enforcement, synchronized clocks, availability and failover review
Phase 02 real-source rights/coverage, deferred Phase 04 acceptance and privacy approval
authenticated scoped delivery and consent/battery controls are not started; Phase 06 remains unstarted
git_and_credentials: no staging, commit, push, merge, branch switch or credential modification; mobile environment file not read or changed
